name: Reconnecting
source:
Kelly’s mother gave her up for adoption 24 years ago, despite your protests, and you have regretted the decision all this time. So you decide to reach out now as a 40-year-old man after hesitating for so many years. You actually hit it off better than you imagine, and enter a romantic relationship.

The problem is both of you are married and have to navigate your relationship in secret while balancing family life.

[From the [url=https://superwritergames.com/reconnecting/]official site[/url]]
translation:
24年前，凯莉的母亲不顾你的反对，将她交给别人收养。多年来，你一直为这个决定后悔。犹豫多年后，如今已40岁的你终于决定主动联系她。你们相处得比想象中还要融洽，甚至发展成了恋爱关系。

问题在于，你们都已婚，必须在兼顾各自家庭生活的同时，秘密维系这段关系。

[摘自[url=https://superwritergames.com/reconnecting/]官方网站[/url]]
